units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣现在位尊名重，身闲心旷，生涯十分安乐。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, now held an exalted rank and a weighty name; free in body and open in spirit, he lived a very peaceful life.

units.source_text: 因此在他保护之下的许多妇女，个个生活安定，万事如意称心，无忧无虑，逍遥度日。

en.t: Therefore the many women under his protection all lived secure lives, with everything going as they wished, free from worry and passing their days at ease.

units.source_text: 只有住在西厅里的这位玉鬘小姐，不幸而遭逢了意外的烦恼，心乱如麻，不知如何对付这义父才好。

en.t: Only Lady Tamakazura, who lived in the west wing, had unfortunately met with an unexpected distress; her heart was in turmoil, and she did not know how she should deal with this adoptive father.

units.source_text: 他同筑紫的那个可恶的大夫监，当然是不能相比的。

en.t: Of course, he could not be compared with that hateful assistant governor from Tsukushi.

units.source_text: 然而外人都确信他们是父女，做梦也想不到有此等事情，

en.t: Yet everyone outside was convinced that they were father and daughter, and would never dream that such a thing could be happening,

units.source_text: 故玉鬘只能独自闷在心里，但觉源氏是个异常讨厌的人。

en.t: so Tamakazura could only keep it shut up in her own heart, feeling that Genji was an extraordinarily detestable man.

units.source_text: 她现在已经到了知情达理的年龄，这样想想，那样想想，

en.t: She had now reached an age when she understood feelings and reason, and as she thought about it this way and that,

units.source_text: 又重新想起了早年丧母之苦，不胜悲伤悼惜。

en.t: she remembered anew the pain of losing her mother in childhood, and was overcome with grief and regret.

units.source_text: 至于源氏呢，此言一经出口，闷在肚里异常痛苦，

en.t: As for Genji, once those words had left his mouth, keeping them buried inside caused him extraordinary anguish,

units.source_text: 然而又得顾虑别人耳目，人前一个字也不敢提及，只在自己心中悲伤。

en.t: yet he also had to consider other people’s eyes and ears; before others he did not dare mention a single word, and only grieved within his own heart.

units.source_text: 他常常前去探望玉鬘，每逢侍女不在身旁而四周寂静之时，便向玉鬘表示恋慕之情。

en.t: He often went to visit Tamakazura, and whenever her attendants were not nearby and the surroundings were quiet, he would express his longing love to her.

units.source_text: 此时玉鬘心中虽然懊恼，但是并不断然拒绝，使他难堪。

en.t: At such times, although Tamakazura felt distressed in her heart, she did not flatly refuse him and put him to shame.

units.source_text: 她只装作不懂的样子，巧妙应付过去。

en.t: She merely pretended not to understand, and skillfully managed to let the matter pass.
